_doc: Stage 1 story beats. Objectives are shown as quiet journal notes (never waypoints). Triggers run actions when conditions are met: flags (all), logsRead (min count), near [x,z,r], time [from,to], once.

objectives.text: The boat is tied to Linden Court. Search the building.
There is smoke to the south-east. Raft-folk. Trade there.
Listen to the boat radio (R). Not every voice is Highmark's.
Someone at Kettle Drift might know what the numbers mean.
The Sounding. Lower the Unmoored hydrophone. At night, if you must.

do.whisper: Cold. The boat rocks. The tower is silent above you.
To the north, on the horizon: Highmark. Still dry. Still lit.
The water here is black. The seabed simply stops.
Night. Lights on the raft. One lamp in a far tower window.
